name: Patih Kadir
role: Intermediary and later Upeh leader in Pires
bio: Kadir carries petitions for the household before taking an independent course. A later captain who asks whose permission counts in Upeh may hear different names.
notes: fact: Birch has him petition for the widow and then lead resistance; Pires connects him with Upeh leadership and says he returned to Java (Birch III, pp. 149–152; Pires II, p. 282)
inference: Birch’s later roster names Regunecerage for Upeh, so an uninterrupted succession is not secure; Kadir is not Pati Unus (Birch III, pp. 166–167; people-factions.md §2)
gameplay: His role as a shipping contact in an aftermath storyline is invented (people-factions.md §2)
